statement.zh: Moseley 1975 海洋生计基础模型 vs Raymond 1981 质疑；内陆灌溉与玉米证据使纯海洋叙事复杂化。
statement.en: Moseley 1975 maritime-foundations model vs Raymond 1981 reconsideration; inland irrigation and maize evidence complicate a purely maritime narrative.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
